documents.text: From bottom half guard, frame against the crossface, turn onto your side, pummel for the under hook, and build up to your elbow instead of accepting chest pressure.
Control the opponent's knee line, bring your shin inside, and connect your foot behind the far leg before entering K guard.
In octopus guard, keep your head higher than their shoulder and attach your hips before reaching around the waist to come up behind them.
Use your butterfly hook and upper-body connection to move their weight forward before trying to elevate or sweep.
The shotgun grip joins both hands around the leg so the knee cannot retract while you expose the heel.
Training journal: I kept getting squashed after the speech recognizer wrote under cook. I need an inside frame and better elbow position.
Training journal: My timing and decision making deteriorated because I arrived exhausted after sleeping badly.
Personal journal: I hesitated to start because I was worried about making a mistake, but taking one small action restored momentum.
Keep your shoulder heavy over the back of the neck and block the near arm before circling behind from front headlock.
Against side control, connect your elbow and knee, create a frame at the hip, bridge to make space, and recover guard.
